name_en: ascending chain theorem for Noetherian rings
canonical_name: ascending-chain stabilization for ideals in a commutative Noetherian ring
literal_source_claim_zh: 诺特环的理想升链条件
literal_source_claim_en: The ascending chain condition for ideals of a Noetherian ring.
canonical_statement: For every commutative ring R in which every ideal is finitely generated, every ascending natural-number-indexed chain of ideals eventually stabilizes.
canonical_claim: For every commutative ring R, if every ideal of R is finitely generated, then for every ascending chain I indexed by the natural numbers there exists n such that I m = I n for every m at least n.
statement_blocker: Before accepting an exact Lean target, the statement phase must independently review the inspected primary passage, ratify the source-matched implication rather than the converse or full biconditional, justify specializing Noether's possibly nonunital rings to modern unital CommRing, fix the ideal-chain encoding and order direction, and elaborate, fingerprint, transport-check, and mutation-test the result.
